language: JavaScript (Node.js 24) rule checks over compose.yaml, a Dockerfile, a FastAPI source file, a GitHub Actions workflow and a YAML design worksheet

failingTests: the workflow runs on push
the test job checks out the repository and runs the tests
the build job runs only after the test job succeeds
the image build keeps its context and pushes only conditionally
every action is pinned to a full commit SHA
registry credentials come from repository secrets, never literals
no step prints a secret to the run log
a permissions block gives GITHUB_TOKEN least access
compose.yaml adds the reviews service built from ./reviews
reviews gets its own postgres:18 database with its own named volume
reviews DATABASE_URL names its own database service, port and database, with the password from .env
reviews waits for its healthy database, which has a pg_isready healthcheck
reviews reaches the shop api at http://api:8080 through API_BASE_URL
reviews publishes a port and every added port binds to 127.0.0.1
the image reference is read as registry, repository and tag
the gateway and discovery questions match the brief
the monolith, microservices and database-per-service questions match the brief
each dataset gets the store its access pattern asks for
the three store types are contrasted on schema, querying and consistency
the pipeline, Kubernetes and delivery questions match the taught distinctions
reviews Dockerfile uses a Python 3 base image and a WORKDIR
reviews Dockerfile installs requirements before copying the app code
reviews Dockerfile starts a server that listens on 0.0.0.0
reviews .dockerignore leaves out caches, version control and secrets
the outgoing api call sets explicit connect and read timeouts
the outgoing api call forwards the caller's token instead of a hard-coded one
a failed or timed-out downstream call becomes a clear 502/503/504 response

cleanup.notes: Delete tests/node_modules (created by npm ci) and starter/.env (your disposable local password file). To redo the lab, restore the edited starter files from version control or a fresh copy of the bundle. The lab creates no database, image, container, workflow run or volume: nothing runs a container engine, Python or any pipeline.
